Noah: quick thread for New Year's vibes 386 share one win from 2025 and one tiny goal for 2026? i'll start. Win: shipped the caching layer that saved us $$$. Goal: learn one new ukulele chord.
Em: Win: helped onboard two major customers. Goal: read 12 books (one per month). :books:
Carlos: Win: reduced inference tail latency by 18%. Goal: try a weekly morning walk.
Yara: Win: ran the holiday ops rota without incident. Goal: bring cookies to the office bakery swap. :cookie:
Noah: love these. tiny FYI: we'll compile these for the all-hands 'wins & wishes' slide if you're ok with that. react with :white_check_mark: to give consent.
Em: :white_check_mark: happy to be on the slide.
Carlos: :white_check_mark: also, shoutout to @Yara for keeping the holiday on-call calm.
Yara: thanks @Carlos! shoutout to @Em for onboarding docs that actually make sense.
new-year-bot: Reminder: Share your one-line goal by 2026-01-05 09:00 PT to be included in the compilation. React with :bell: to opt into a follow-up check-in.
Noah: optional fun: post a 1-sentence success tip for 2026 too (work or life). mine: schedule deep work early and protect it.
Em: tip: stop checking email for the first 30 minutes of the day.
Carlos: tip: write the small annoying ticket first thing 4dd (it shortens the whole day).
Yara: tip: bring a real mug, not a disposable one 37a small planet wins.
Noah: last call: feel free to drop gifs or emojis, keep it short. happy almost new year, team :sparkler:
